summary: Verified the Users tab crash fix and full EN/ES translation regression across the admin dashboard. Logged in as super admin, cycled through all 8 dashboard tabs (Overview, Users, Payments, Attendance, Notify, Blog, CMS, Permissions) in BOTH English and Spanish — zero runtime errors, zero 'TypeError: t is not a function' occurrences. Users panel renders with data-testid=users-panel. Language toggle flips <html lang> and localStorage yk_lang between en/es. All expected EN column headers (Name/Email/Role/Belt/Member No./Status/Actions) and ES headers (Nombre/Correo/Rol/Cinturón/Núm. Miembro/Estado/Acciones) are present. UserDrawer opens without errors and shows the correct tab labels in both languages (Profile/Information/ID Card/Security ↔ Perfil/Información/Credencial/Seguridad). Add User modal and Edit ID Cards shortcut also open cleanly. Bug fix is CONFIRMED resolved.

issues: React hydration warning: <span> rendered as child of <option>. The <select> option elements wrap dynamic student names in a <span data-ve-dynamic> which is invalid HTML inside <option>. Non-fatal (page still works) but produces a console error and could break option rendering in some browsers. Recommend rendering the student name as plain text child of <option>.

action_items: Optional: address hydration warning in AdminDashboard.jsx around line 370 — <option> element must contain text-only children, not <span>. Currently a data-ve-dynamic <span> wrapper is being injected which triggers a React hydration console error.
critical_code_review_comments: Fix looks solid: every previously-crashing subcomponent (UsersPanel, PaymentsPanel, PaymentsTabPanel, CMSPanel, NewPaymentModal, EditPageModal) and all wrapped panels (Attendance, Notifications, Blog, Permissions, UserDrawer) now call const { t } = useT() at their own scope. Verified via grep and live navigation.
i18n dictionary is comprehensive with matching EN/ES keys for all covered surfaces; missing keys fall back gracefully.

AdminDashboard.jsx is now >500 lines and contains 6+ inline sub-panel components (UsersPanel, PaymentsTabPanel, PaymentsPanel, CMSPanel, NewPaymentModal, EditPageModal). Consider extracting these to /components/*.jsx to prevent this exact class of bug recurring (subcomponent using hooks from outer closure).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Bug fix for the Users-tab TypeError has been fully verified in EN and ES. Only remaining item is a low-priority React hydration warning in the Payments 'Bill Student' <select> (span inside option). No further retest required for the translation regression itself.
rca of the issue: Original crash: UsersPanel (declared as an inline component inside AdminDashboard.jsx) was calling t() which was not in its scope — the outer parent component owned useT() but UsersPanel was defined as its own function component and did not call useT() itself. Fix: added `const { t } = useT();` at the top of each affected inline subcomponent. Verified during this test run that all 8 tabs in both languages render without 'TypeError: t is not a function' and no other subcomponents suffer the same issue.
